# Ground-truth SH-4 function entry points
#
# Source: https://github.com/EstexNT/rhythmtengokuarcade
#   commit c2c1cda7d9a7f15fcee232d8a4abeced3b273634 (2024-04-28)
# These are the `func_0cXXXXXX` entries split out under that repo's
# asm/entry.s and asm/code_0c0*/ directories — an INDEPENDENT
# manual/matching disassembly of the same decrypted fpr-24423.ic8.
# They are the external check that fixed our base address (0x0C01FB00)
# and that validate tools/find_func_boundaries_v3.py.  Addresses only
# — no ROM bytes — so safe to commit.
#
# These 181 functions COMPLETELY cover the window [0x0C020000,
# 0x0C026FDC); everything above 0x0C026FDC is still one bindata blob in
# EstexNT's decomp.  Within the window the set is exhaustive, so it
# checks our scanner's PRECISION (no invented functions) as well as its
# recall (see tools/validate_groundtruth.py).
#
